title: 「Unlike X, Y …」句

source.file: Sentence Structure 254 -「Unlike X, Y …」表達對比.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than this system lesson ID because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formulas.formula: Unlike + X, + Y + verb + other information.
Y, unlike + X, + verb + other information.
Y + verb + other information, unlike + X.
unlike me / you / him / her / us / them

example: Unlike the first proposal, the second includes a clear budget.
exampleZh: 與第一個提案不同，第二個提案包含清晰的預算。

examples.en: Unlike the first proposal, the second includes a clear budget.
examples.zh: 與第一個提案不同，第二個提案包含清晰的預算。
examples.highlight: Unlike the first proposal, the second includes a clear budget.

examples.zh: 第二個提案與第一個不同，包含清晰的預算。

examples.en: The northern path remains open in winter, unlike the southern path.
examples.zh: 北面的路徑在冬季仍然開放，南面的路徑則不同。
examples.highlight: The northern path remains open in winter, unlike the southern path.

meaning.zh: 使用 unlike + 比較對象，直接指出兩個人物、事物、活動或情況之間的不同。

rules.zh: X 和 Y 必須屬同類，或在邏輯上可以互相比較。
rules.en: Compare similar types of things. X and Y must be logically comparable.

rules.zh: unlike 短語放在句首時，短語後通常加逗號。
rules.en: Use a comma after an opening unlike phrase.

rules.zh: unlike 短語插入主句中間時，通常在短語前後各加逗號。
rules.en: Use two commas for a middle unlike phrase.

rules.zh: 主要句式中，unlike 後應接名詞短語、代名詞或 -ing 短語，不應直接接完整獨立子句；如比較兩個完整子句，使用 whereas 或 while。
rules.en: Do not normally place a complete independent clause directly after unlike. Use a noun phrase, pronoun or -ing phrase; use whereas or while when two complete clauses are required.

rules.zh: 時間、地點或其他額外資料可以省略；核心結構仍是 unlike + comparison item。
rules.en: Extra information is optional. The core expression remains unlike plus a comparison item.

benefits.zh: 能立即顯示兩個人物、事物或情況之間的不同。
benefits.en: It makes the difference clear immediately.

benefits.zh: 能把兩項資料順暢合併成一句。
benefits.en: It combines two ideas into one sentence.

benefits.zh: 能避免反覆使用 but、while 和 whereas。
benefits.en: It helps avoid repeating but, while and whereas.

benefits.zh: unlike 短語可放在句首、句中或句末，增加句子開首和結構的變化。
適合用來比較計劃、產品、人物、地點、制度、結果和經歷。
benefits.en: It is useful in comparison writing and speaking.

benefits.zh: 改變 unlike 短語的位置，可以調整讀者先注意的重點。
benefits.en: Its position can change the emphasis.

en: Rewrite each item as one sentence using unlike.
The unlike phrase may appear at the beginning, in the middle or at the end of the answer.
Preserve the original meaning, tense, people, objects and important details.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用 unlike，把每題改寫成一句完整句子。
unlike 短語可以放在答案的句首、句中或句末。
保留原句的意思、時態、人物、物件和重要資料。
每題已提供答案的第一個字。

questions.answer: The smaller venue, unlike the larger one, has better transport links.
questions.answerZh: 較小的場地與較大的場地不同，有較好的交通接駁。
questions.highlight: The smaller venue, unlike the larger one, has better transport links.

questions.prompt: The former safety procedure did not require two staff members to check the equipment, but the new procedure does.
questions.promptZh: 之前的安全程序沒有要求兩名職員檢查設備，但新程序有此要求。
questions.answer: Unlike the former safety procedure, the new procedure requires two staff members to check the equipment.
questions.answerZh: 與之前的安全程序不同，新程序要求兩名職員檢查設備。
questions.highlight: Unlike the former safety procedure, the new procedure requires two staff members to check the equipment.

questions.prompt: The advertisement suggested that the course included individual coaching, but the course does not include it.
questions.promptZh: 廣告暗示課程包含個別指導，但課程並不包括這項服務。
questions.answer: The course does not include individual coaching, unlike what the advertisement suggested.
questions.answerZh: 課程並不包括個別指導，與廣告所暗示的內容不同。
questions.highlight: The course does not include individual coaching, unlike what the advertisement suggested.

questions.prompt: The first interview revealed no practical problems, whereas the second interview revealed several.
questions.promptZh: 第一次訪問沒有揭示任何實際問題，而第二次訪問則揭示了數個問題。
questions.answer: Unlike the first interview, the second interview revealed several practical problems.
questions.answerZh: 與第一次訪問不同，第二次訪問揭示了數個實際問題。
questions.highlight: Unlike the first interview, the second interview revealed several practical problems.

questions.prompt: The old booking system did not allow patients to change appointments online, but the hospital’s new system does.
questions.promptZh: 舊預約系統不容許病人在網上更改預約，但醫院的新系統可以。
questions.answer: The hospital’s new booking system, unlike the old system, allows patients to change appointments online.
questions.answerZh: 醫院的新預約系統與舊系統不同，容許病人在網上更改預約。
questions.highlight: The hospital’s new booking system, unlike the old system, allows patients to change appointments online.
